summary: Phase 2 scope covers policy guidance and use-specific zoning standards for data centers, utility substations, microgrids and generators. Drafting window October 2025 through August 2026, with two public open house events in September 2026.
notes: The only jurisdiction in this corpus writing standards for microgrids and generators as land uses alongside data centers. Loudoun facilities are separately reported to operate approximately 4,700 backup generators. Phase 1 was approved March 18 2025 on a 7-2 vote, Supervisors Umstattd and Kershner dissenting, after initiation February 6 2024 and an Intent to Amend approved July 2 2024.
confidence_note: Phase 2 draft text has not been read and may not exist in public form. Whether microgrids survive into the drafted standards is NOT_CHECKED.
